svg.title: How much of the weight lost was lean mass, GLP-1 drug alone vs with an experimental muscle drug
svg.desc: Share of weight lost that was DXA lean mass. QUALITY: 31.9% on semaglutide with placebo vs 9.4% with enobosarm. EMBRAZE: 30.2% on tirzepatide with placebo vs 14.6% with apitegromab. COURAGE: 34% on semaglutide alone vs 8 to 18% with trevogrumab. BELIEVE: 28.9% on semaglutide 2.4 mg vs 7.7% with bimagrumab. Different trials, durations and people; all company-funded; DXA lean mass is not the same as muscle.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On a GLP-1 alone, about 3 in 10 pounds lost were lean mass

svg.text: Not head-to-head: different trials, drugs, doses, lengths and people. All four were funded by the company

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: making the muscle drug, and none of these drugs is approved. DXA “lean” includes water and organs, not just muscle.
